title: Teaching Scaffolding Import: Zone of Proximal Development Applied to Weak-to-Strong Oversight

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If ZPD explains weak-to-strong generalization, it provides a principled framework predicting exactly when weak oversight will work and when it will fail. This would be a major theoretical contribution to oversight design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Operationalizing ZPD for AI oversight requires defining task difficulty zones, which is conceptually accessible but requires careful experimental design. Running the experiment on existing weak-to-strong code is feasible. Moderate for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Requires categorizing tasks into three difficulty zones and running weak-to-strong generalization on each. The categorization itself is a design challenge. Feasible but not tightly scoped for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
